decisions.reason: As a multi-item consumer-health range launched with its own page and clear fit with the firm's announced portfolio expansion, prior investment and visible commitment make management likely to continue it unless results are clearly poor.

This joint-health supplement fits the established dietary supplement portfolio, and although its visibility is limited and several years have passed, management can still justify keeping it because the commitment is already made and the category remains strategically relevant.

The niche immune supplement has the weakest commercial position of the remaining supplements, but its fit with the consumer-health broadening and the tendency to persist with already launched products still tilt management toward continuation.

Despite being more distant from the earlier offer, the OTC migraine product required visible launch commitment and regulatory effort and supports the stated move into new consumer-health products, so management would be inclined to retain it.
